text:
lian: Hey @here — quick heads up, welcoming our new IC, @sam, starting Monday. wanted to confirm who we should cc for common first-week access and oncall routing. :)

maria: welcome @sam! :tada: cc me for infra/VPC/KMS access — I own cloud infra access requests.

devon: hi @sam — for repo perms and CI tokens ping @zach (platform). I can also add you to the internal repo list if you give me your GitHub handle.

sam: thanks all — my GH is samk-rl. also need slack channel invites and badge/door access. who owns badges?

lian: @people-ops handles badges, but @maria usually kicks off the network/VPC/KMS approvals that people-ops needs. @people-ops is out of this thread but I'll add them.

maria: yep, I'll start the infra ticket. for badge you need to fill out the campus form: https://intranet/redwood/badges — people-ops will confirm.

zach: @sam I'll grant repo access once @devon confirms which teams you should belong to. also, if you'll be on Dedicated infra work, let me know and I'll add Dedicated-read/write scopes.

sam: planning to work on Dedicated routing + optimization. please add write if that's okay.

devon: noted — I'll add you to dedicated-team and infra-router. Zach, can you also add CI token access?

zach: sure. CI token = project-ci, will grant after org invite.

sam: oncall? who do I page if something is broken for Dedicated?

oncall-bot: Reminder: Oncall rota lives at https://wiki/redwood/oncall. Primary for Dedicated this week: devon, backup: maria.

maria: correct — for immediate pages page the #eng-oncall channel or use the pager from the wiki. For escalation beyond SRE, page the Platform lead.

lian: to summarize who-to-cc for first week onboarding: people-ops (badges/HR), maria (infra/VPC/KMS), zach (repos/CI), devon (team owner & oncall), and @eng-platform for higher-level routing. I can DM people-ops and eng-platform to add you now.

sam: awesome, thanks. one more — who owns access to the password manager vaults for infra team?

maria: infra vaults are in 1Password under the "infra" team. you need org SSO + membership in infra group. I'll send an invite.

devon: also note: when you request infra keys, include the service names and duration. we try to give short-lived access first.

sam: got it — will include service names.

lian: final checklist I'll send after this thread: slack channels, repo invites, badge form link, infra ticket id, oncall rota link, and who to cc for pager/escalation.

zach: FYI @sam — if you need Dedicated GPU access there is a separate quota request form: https://intranet/redwood/compute-requests.

sam: thanks everyone — this is super helpful. feel free to DM me any invites. :thumbsup:

lian: welcome again! see you Monday :)
